turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric, so I can't give a GMV figure for September 2026. The closest metrics are Orders (orders_total: all orders placed, cancelled included, counted as a number of orders, not a value) and Revenue (revenue_eur: sum of amounts for non-cancelled orders, which excludes cancelled ones).
